SIGNALS.name: CNBC
SIGNALS.summary: CNBC reports Anthropic will invest $100 million to train AI engineering talent.

SIGNALS.name: Arena.ai
SIGNALS.summary: Arena.ai says Claude Sonnet 5.5 landed at #3 in its Agent Arena, with a median cost per task of $2.74, higher than the #2 Claude Opus 5.5 at $1.58.

SIGNALS.name: AI at Meta
SIGNALS.summary: Meta says mathematicians worked with its AI over several months on problems with no known solution path, after its models earned gold-medal-level results in five STEM competitions.

SIGNALS.name: NVIDIA RTX Spark
SIGNALS.summary: NVIDIA says DGX Spark is getting a 64GB option built on the GB10 Grace Blackwell Superchip, for running local agents on device, with a new Sync Cluster Assistant for pairing systems.

SIGNALS.name: AGTP
SIGNALS.summary: Says OpenAI's Tibo posted that a usage reset for all paid ChatGPT accounts, covering ChatGPT Work and Codex, lands tomorrow at 10am PST.

SIGNALS.name: Chubby
SIGNALS.summary: Relays a Google DeepMind engineer's pushback on a Bloomberg report that Gemini 4 scores well on benchmarks but underperforms when employees use it at work.

SIGNALS.name: Google VRP (Google Bug Hunters)
SIGNALS.summary: Google's bug bounty team says it is temporarily no longer accepting OSS VRP product vulnerability submissions; supply chain reports and outstanding reports are not affected.
